steps.title: Gather on the Usurper in the south
steps.cue: The Usurper of Frost reappears south of the middle
steps.rule: Run to the Usurper as she comes back: MT tanks her from the north side with OT beside him, melee on her east and west flanks, healers and ranged spread between her and the middle.

MainTank.rule: Pick her up from the north side, about 4 m in front of her, so she faces the middle.

OffTank.rule: Stand next to the MT on her north side.
